title: Homeowner Acknowledgment Terms and Production Start — Factory Production Orders
content:
**Terms.** After entry the factory issues an order acknowledgment listing every unit's size, configuration, color and glass, and the customer signs it to confirm the specification; the signature is recorded as the acknowledgment signed checkpoint. An acknowledgment counts as on time only when the customer signs it no later than the return window after the order entry date. Business days are counted starting the day after the order entry date, Monday through Friday excluding U.S. federal holidays, and a signature on the last day of the window is on time. Production can start only after the customer has signed the order acknowledgment. In the Specialty Shape Build class production additionally waits for the template received checkpoint. Production starts within the class queue time after the later of those checkpoints. A unit failing the factory quality check is remade as a factory defect.

These terms apply to all Factory Production Orders; the return window and the queue time are the figures of the order's build class.

## Retired clause

The following sentence of these terms is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current basis for late-acknowledgment delay notices: "When the acknowledgment is signed late, a delay notice with cause late acknowledgment moves the current ship date later by the number of business days the signature came after the window."

## The on-time test

| Element | Setting |
|---|---|
| Clock starts | the order entry date shown on the factory order record |
| Counting | business days, starting the day after the order entry date; Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays |
| Length | the class acknowledgment return window |
| Comparison | the signature date must be no later than the last day of the window |
| Last day of the window | a signature on that day is on time |
| Evidence | the date of the acknowledgment signed checkpoint on the order's milestone records |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, return window of 3 business days, no federal holiday in the period)

- Order entered on a Monday: the window runs Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday. Signed Thursday — on time. Signed Friday — late.
- Order entered on a Thursday: the window runs Friday, Monday, Tuesday. Signed Tuesday — on time. Signed Wednesday — late.

## Production start

- Production waits for the acknowledgment signed checkpoint on the order's records; a customer's statement that the acknowledgment was signed is not that record.
- For a Specialty Shape Build order production also waits for the template received checkpoint, and the class queue time runs from the later of the two checkpoints.

superseded_clauses: When the acknowledgment is signed late, a delay notice with cause late_acknowledgment moves the current ship date later by the number of business days the signature came after the window.
